### Universe screen (forex)

11 assets, 1999-01-04 → 2026-08-21; 38 pairs pass the correlation prefilter (≥ 0.5); 3 of them reject the Engle-Granger null at 5%. With 55 candidate pairs, ≈ 3 would pass at 5% by pure chance (Clegg 2014), so this screen is *descriptive*: performance claims come only from the walk-forward section below.
